documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Unaudited Financial Results For Quarter And Half-Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Somany Ceramics Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings where stand-alone sales grew moderately by 3% in volume and 24% in value, constrained by the temporary 1.5-month shutdown in Morbi during April. EBITDA margins improved by 3.6% to 11.6% due to higher capacity utilization (reaching 83% stand-alone) and a turnaround in joint ventures from losses to profits. Management highlighted significant volatility in natural gas prices, which have seen increases of 16% to 18%, though these have been successfully passed on through price hikes. The company announced plans for a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South requiring a capex of approximately INR220 crores, alongside debottlenecking and balancing equipment across existing plants to be operational by late FY27. Somany Ceramics reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27 with consolidated revenue growing 24% year-on-year to INR 744 crore and EBITDA margin improving to 11.6%.

guidance.claim: Management maintains that the EBITDA margins delivered in the quarter will be maintained or bettered.
guidance.quote: And we maintain that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter would be maintained, and we are trying to better our EBITDA margins, which we have delivered in last quarter and on this quarter.

guidance.claim: The company expects mid-single-digit volume growth for the year.
Management targets achieving EBITDA margins of 12% and more.
guidance.quote: Yes, absolutely. That's the target that we achieve 12% and more.

guidance.claim: The company guides to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more from the base.
guidance.quote: Now for the guidance. Now the caveat is there's no further shocks geopolitically. But otherwise, our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

guidance.claim: Management targets a very aggressive double-digit growth for sanitaryware.
guidance.quote: Sanitaryware has done fairly well. We've grown by 8% for the entire year, and we have closed the figure at INR320 crores, up from INR296 crores. And this year, we've taken a very aggressive target, a very aggressive double-digit target.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand in May and June was quite decent, and July has been relatively stable despite seasonal rains.
demand_outlook.quote: Other than that, the demand of May and June has been pretty decent. July also has been not bad considering that there's been rains in many parts of the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Morbi exports have dropped by 50% to 60% from their peak due to geopolitical reasons.
demand_outlook.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is extremely bullish about the future demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, we are extremely bullish of the future outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Channel inventory is not overly full because dealers remain cautious regarding potential gas price drops.
demand_outlook.quote: They are presuming that the gas price will come down overnight and then there may be a price reduction. So channel people are not taking the inventory they should be taking.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the industry's growth prospects supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the industry’s growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.

demand_outlook.claim: April demand was slow as consumers took time to absorb price increases and dealers were cautious about higher-value material.
demand_outlook.quote: So, all of these three reasons, April was kind of a -- for us, it was a little bit of growth, but it wasn't a flat month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, ready in 12 to 15 months for INR350 crores potential revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months. This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional capacity of 4 million to 5 million square meters will be added across existing lines from mid-quarter 3 to quarter 4.
capex_expansion.quote: Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South. All put together, we will be adding another 4 million to 5 million for the mid -- this will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and would be completely in place in quarter 4.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex outlay from now to the end of FY27 is approximately INR275 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So from now to '27 end, we have already looked at approximately INR275 crores outlay, which includes the INR220 crores plant plus balancing equipment in various other plants and some more balancing equipment in the Bathware, sanitaryware plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm of Glazed Vitrified Tiles to cater to the Southern market.
capex_expansion.quote: To cater to the growing Southern market, the Company has announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm. of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested INR30 crores to improve utilization levels at Somany Max by installing a new press.
capex_expansion.quote: We put in an investment of INR30 crores to make the utilization level better in Somany Max by putting the press.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex for the year will be contained within INR70 crores to INR80 crores for routine capex and balancing equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: So everything will be contained in the INR70 crores, INR80 crores of routine capex and balancing equipment to make our assets more value-added or more -- towards more capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins rose by 3.6% to 11.6% due to operational efficiencies and capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: As a result of capacity utilization, our EBITDA margins have gone up on operational efficiencies, both on capacity utilization in our plants and also on the JV performances. So EBITDA margins go up by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Natural gas prices have seen increases between 16% and 18%, which were successfully passed on.
margins_costs.quote: Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price. Fortunately, we've been able to pass on all the gas price increase until now. So the current price increase has been between 16% and 18%.

margins_costs.claim: Blended natural gas price stands at approximately INR68 in the North and mid-70s in the South and Morbi.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. So our blended price comes in at about INR68. And South, we're still buying partly in spot. So South is -- South and Morbi are pretty much at the same level, which is close to mid-70s. And in the North, it is slightly lower, which is around the INR68, INR69 level.

margins_costs.claim: Joint ventures swung from a INR10 crores loss in the same quarter last year to a INR3 crores profit.
margins_costs.quote: This time is a profit of INR3 crores, and this would only get better going forward.

margins_costs.claim: Somany Max reduced its loss from INR7 crores last year to slightly over INR1 crore this quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So Somany Max last year, same quarter, we had a INR7 crores minus. And this time, we have a INR1-point-something crore minus.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA improved quite significantly by 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% for the entire year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA improved quite significantly, 3.2% in Q4 and about 1% in the entire year.

margins_costs.claim: Gas prices increased very significantly following geopolitical events after March 9th.
margins_costs.quote: Gas price, as you all know, has increased very significantly, which we can talk about that. I'm sure there'll be a lot of question-answers around that.

margins_costs.claim: Input cost increases have been passed on entirely in retail and about 85% in projects.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost increase currently has been passed on to an extent, and we can talk about that in the Q&A.

margins_costs.claim: Brand spend for the year was about 2%, slightly lower due to getting rid of the superstar.
margins_costs.quote: As far as our business is concerned, our brand spend has been about 2% for the year. We got rid of the superstar and therefore, it's slightly lower because of that reason.

orders_capacity.claim: Morbi operations resumed 100% production using gas supplied by GEL.
orders_capacity.quote: Morbi operations have completely started. They have resumed 100% production on very expensive gas, which is on -- which is being supplied by GEL, formerly known as GSPCL.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization was largely flat, moving from approximately 80% to 79% for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization was largely flat from approximately 80% to 79%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Max plant achieved a near breakeven in Q4 compared to a loss of INR9 crores in the corresponding quarter last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Max plant did -- there's good news there that we almost did a breakeven at Max plant. Corresponding quarter last year, same quarter of Q4, the loss was about INR9 crores. So from that, we've been able to breakeven Max.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added a net of 200 dealers across India, taking total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.
orders_capacity.quote: The net dealer addition has been very strong this year. We've added net new additions of 200 dealers across India, taking the total dealer showrooms to about 3,100.

orders_capacity.claim: Plants across the country are currently running at 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So we're running plant at 100% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days dropped from 17 to 12 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days also have come down from 17 to 12 days.

capital_allocation.claim: About 65% to 70% of the planned capex will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: So again, we're not putting pressure on the balance sheet at all. And the loan which will be taken, the small loan, which will be taken in the joint venture with no corporate guarantee from Somany side.

capital_allocation.claim: The company cannot do a share buyback for the next 6 to 8 months due to an embargo from SEBI while consolidating wholly owned subsidiaries.
capital_allocation.quote: Unfortunately, we are consolidating some of our JV -- sorry, our wholly owned subs, and therefore, there is an embargo on -- from SEBI. We can't do a share buyback for the next 6, 8 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices have been extremely volatile with incremental increases each month.
risks_headwinds.quote: The gas price has been extremely volatile. I had mentioned that in the earnings call for the FY26, but the gas price since then has been extremely volatile. Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price.

risks_headwinds.claim: April sales were impacted because Morbi was shut for about 1.5 months.
risks_headwinds.quote: The sales growing only at 3% is due to April, we did not get a certain segment which we were generally buying from Morbi. As you all know that Morbi was shut for the entire 1.5 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports from Morbi are down 50% to 60% due to geopolitical reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Morbi operations faced major labor shortages, with about 60% to 65% of Morbi up and running.
risks_headwinds.quote: The situation currently in Morbi is that whoever has started up is facing a little bit of challenge with labor. There a major, major, major labor shortage in Morbi. As a result of that, as we speak today, approximately 60%, 65% of Morbi is up and running.

risks_headwinds.claim: March was an aberration month due to geopolitical circumstances that halted exports and shipping.
risks_headwinds.quote: Obviously, March was a very aberration month because of the various circumstances which played out geopolitically.

management_commitments.claim: The new plant in the South will be operational in the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

management_commitments.claim: The capacity enhancements from balancing equipment will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and fully in place by quarter 4.
management_commitments.quote: All put together, we will be adding another 4 million to 5 million for the mid -- this will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and would be completely in place in quarter 4.

management_commitments.claim: The new southern plant will be operational towards the third quarter of next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, end of quarter 3, beginning quarter 4 of next year, it will be operational.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that their focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will continue to leverage their strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to leverage our strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to improve EBITDA margin from the current base by at least 1.5% or more.
management_commitments.quote: Now for the guidance. Now the caveat is there's no further shocks geopolitically. But otherwise, our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects capacity in Morbi to reach about 85% by the end of the month.
management_commitments.quote: And I believe by the end of this month, it would -- the number would reach about 85%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
